name: relaxed-streetwear-portrait
image_purpose: streetwear lookbook and lifestyle fashion portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a medium full-body vertical studio lifestyle portrait of one approved adult woman in relaxed streetwear, preserving the supplied garment typography and muted palette.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with round-to-oval face, light brown or hazel eyes, natural straight brows, visible freckles, medium-brown long hair in two low braids with loose front strands, and relaxed mildly introspective expression. She wears a dark-green baseball cap with 'IDOL' lettering, oversized dark-green fleece sweatshirt with white-and-gold collegiate 'Atlanta Georgia' lettering and sleeve patch, black track pants with white piping, black-and-white sneakers, and layered thin chain necklaces.
composition_elements: Vertical medium full-body portrait with the subject centered.
Seated on the floor with one knee raised and head resting on one hand.
Light-gray seamless matte studio backdrop fully in focus.
Dark green, black, gray, white, gold, and muted-yellow palette.
Preserve visible garment typography and its chest/sleeve placement.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused frontal studio light, gentle fill, minimal soft-edged shadows, neutral-to-slightly-cool color temperature, even exposure.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR or mirrorless portrait camera, 35–50mm equivalent lens, high overall clarity, minimal skin retouching, cool-neutral grading, vertical full-body framing, no additional text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a medium full-body vertical studio lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with a round-to-oval face, light brown or hazel eyes, natural straight brows, visible freckles across cheeks and nose, medium-brown long hair in two low braids with loose front strands, and a relaxed mildly introspective expression. She wears a dark-green baseball cap with 'IDOL' lettering, an oversized dark-green cotton-fleece sweatshirt with white-and-gold collegiate 'Atlanta Georgia' lettering and sleeve patch, black plush track pants with white side piping, black-and-white street sneakers, and layered thin chain necklaces. She sits on the floor with one knee raised and head resting on one hand, centered against a smooth light-gray seamless studio backdrop. Soft diffused frontal light, gentle fill, moderate depth of field with background in focus, cool-neutral streetwear editorial, 35–50mm portrait lens, realistic texture, no added text, no watermark.
